ctx.x: I wouldn't be surprised if that wasn't the kind of thing that Bolden... You talk to somebody like Peter Boccage, you know, he says that Bolden played just, you know, nothing but the blues, strictly lower class people, no musical imagination. Well, that sounds like rock and roll to me. Of course, it's not the same, you know, electric guitars and all that, but that's probably more of the spirit. People like to go and dance to it. Boppy music. That's right. Oh, it's a shame to see those poor little high school girls…
